Penal Code, 1860-Sections 306 and 107-Abetment of suicide-On facts, strained relation between parties-Quarrel between the parties where C appellant allegedly using abusive language and telling the deceased to go and die-Deceased coming home in an inebriated condition day after quarrel and next day and sense-Appellant charge-sheeted­ Whether appellant abetted commission of such suicide-Held, no since suicide not direct result of quarrel-Further to say 'to go and die', itself does not D constitute ingredient of instigation.
